![image_20260408_174356_0000](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23ynL5yXAnKejAiAy2X3MtoHd38EniQ1gipgyMy2inJ1cfvyjZNpHDFwL35hGYLKaXr26.png)



What a beautiful sunny day friends!

Hello everyone how are you all doing? I hope you are having a great time just like me. I am here today to share with you our visit to Baler Fishport right here in our place. My goal is simple I want to find the best views and take nice pictures so I can show you all just how beautiful our area really is. I was really excited to go there and see everything with my own eyes.
 
![image_20260408_173000_0010](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23r1Y6N1oGEN4Xsf3T73x1igopBgCjXQpy3jP9qUVs3meGh3r2BAanDWbvqfwEE8grLxA.png)


When I first arrived I was already amazed by what I saw. The sky was so bright and perfectly blue with just a few soft white clouds floating around. The sun was shining so strong, making the whole place look so clear and alive. The water was sparkling like little diamonds because of the sunlight. Just standing there and looking at the view already made me feel so happy and relaxed. It was really the perfect kind of day to go out.
 

![image_20260408_173000_0011](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243zQysH8PRYBaLHJTvxaKXT6UeRghGDKv6uCtUaUPASyk1nc9ZBa7zZrP6tbgZqMqnDQ.png)

I walked along the long concrete pier that goes straight out into the water. It is such a big and strong structure. As I walked I could feel the fresh wind blowin from the sea. It felt so cool and nice on my skin especially since it was a bit hot outside. On both sides I could see the water moving gently and sometimes small waves would hit the sides of the pier. From here you can see everything so clearly and it looks really wide and amazing.

![image_20260408_173000_0012](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/244e3boArG89fej2QSiqd8Eu5jGwhyAuZpVqrapqN1gbGeBAh6RszJa1Wxv4fjc3o6jH1.png)
 

Looking at the sea the water was such a beautiful color of blue. It was not just one color too. Near the shore it was lighter and you could even see some rocks and green plants under the water. As you look further out it becomes a deeper and darker blue. It was so clear and clean looking. Far away the sea meets the sky and it looks like they are just one big blue space. It really is a wonderful sight to see.
 

![image _20260408_172959_0004](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243WJyHtiGVFgTnHX2suFgELhaaaSAVdvXtDiuVQzh9WEiZZjX1xUNfLSavu2r2cvUecV.png)

There were also many boats floating on the water. Some were small fishing boats just staying there calmly moving up and down with the waves. These boats are very important to us because they are what our fishermen use to work and bring food for everyone. Seeing them there reminds me of how our town lives and works closely with the ocean. They look so nice and they really add to the beauty of the place.
 

![image_20260408_172959_0005](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/2432BASuoegrwXzBC7N9PDsC8LMGG5CgH57Jfo6Gkog3obwjV6kNWaGCY3v2S5wQV3R51.png)

I also noticed the buildings and structures around. There is this really nice two story building painted in blue and white. It stands out so nicely against the sea and the sky. It looks clean and well built. There are also street lights and posts all around the area showing that this place is well taken care of and ready for people to use anytime. It is good to see that our facilities are not only useful but also look good and neat.
 


![image_20260408_172959_0006](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/245HDNmwzcB5Z6W2PjPpwre2V4PgadRdjiSLA6Wsrbz1QEdRsjLvbeRrsFHYzuMmypRa7.png)


Around the sides there is also plenty of green nature. Tall coconut trees and other leafy trees are growing happily near the water. They look so fresh and green. It is really nice to see how the man-made things like the pier and buildings mix perfectly with the trees and nature. In the background you can also see the big green mountains surrounding our town. They look so full of life and they make the whole view look like a perfect picture.
 



![image_20260408_172959_0009](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243q6kYDC6Hm1NeZsUAajQRiEmHpgKUhQYVEMmm8SeQenDqzegCZavB2F62QznWMfqoSZ.png)



I kept walking around and exploring different spots. Everywhere I looked the view was different but equally beautiful. From some places, you see more of the wide ocean. From others, you see the boats closer or the trees along the shore. I was really trying my best to find the best angles so I could take good pictures. I wanted to capture all the beauty so that even if you are not here you can still see how wonderful Baler Fishport really is.
 

![image_20260408_172959_0008](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/244xsKuQ6XjpPo4pejkPS5byQ3hwgoFKYN8A5yyrGv5fFCpXLuXD1XYzqk9dfu6HjHTKV.png)

The feeling there was just so calm and peaceful. Even though it is a place where people work and come and go it still feels very relaxing. The sound of the wind and the water is so nice to hear. You can just stand there breathe in the fresh air and forget about your problems for a while. I think that is one of the best things about our town we have places that are useful for work but also beautiful enough to make you feel good.
 

![image_20260408_172959_0009](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/243q6kYDC6Hm1NeZsUAajQRiEmHpgKUhQYVEMmm8SeQenDqzegCZavB2F62QznWMfqoSZ.png)

I also thought about how this fishport is not just a place or a building. It is a very big part of our lives here in Baler. It connects us to the sea which gives us food and work. It is where our fishermen start their day and where they come back. It shows the hard work and spirit of the people here. Knowing that made me feel even more proud to show this place to you. It is special not just because it looks good but because it means a lot to us.
 

![image _20260408_172958_0001](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/242rkaepYhJsnsknupnPKFzr4exnjiPU3xRQ4fMVG8MpBL2h77UKqcms33isj88GjfnMg.png)



While I was taking pictures I was imagining all of you seeing them. I really hope that through these photos you can feel the same happiness and pride that I feel. The bright sun, the blue water the boats and the green trees all of these together make this place truly amazing. It shows that we are lucky to live in a place that has so much natural beauty and is also well cared for. There is beauty everywhere you look.
 

![image_20260408_172958_0002](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/244UfC15s9XpjVxZp7o2z4o9vWDDhaQxpuxbSPjXCrVYZU7n6atGLH9eRyoQ2a89w2bSj.png)

Before I went home I looked back one last time. The sun was still shining bright the water was still sparkling and everything looked just as beautiful as when I arrived. I felt so happy and satisfied because I know I got lots of nice pictures to share. It was a great experience going there and it reminded me again how lucky we are to have such a beautiful place right here near us. It is definitely worth visiting and showing off.
 

![image_20260408_172958_0003](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23v4LziCxvaHD3U2g9BH3YMx6p16rshhTNHZeyaa2FanYGd37dPfDFAwABHE9n69bXNMg.png)

So friends, that is my story and the pictures from Baler Fishport. I hope you enjoyed seeing and reading about it. It really is a beautiful spot that shows the best of what we have here in Baler, Aurora. From the clear water to the boats and the green nature it has everything. Thank you for joining me in this little tour. Take care everyone and always appreciate the beautiful places around us!

Una caminata con personas agradables siempre se disfruta mucho más, y esta no fue la excepción. Empezamos reuniéndonos en Caldas, con muy buena energía desde temprano. Desde allí tomamos un carro hacia el Alto de Minas, un trayecto de aproximadamente 12 a 15 kilómetros, que nos tomó entre 20 y 30 minutos, rodeados de paisajes verdes que ya nos iban conectando con la naturaleza.
Al llegar, hicimos una pausa para tomarnos un café caliente, perfecto para el frío de la mañana, y realizamos un calentamiento para preparar el cuerpo. Ese momento fue ideal para respirar profundo, relajarnos y empezar a desconectarnos del ruido de la rutina.
Luego iniciamos el recorrido con una subida por la montaña, siguiendo un camino ancestral que se sentía lleno de historia y tranquilidad. El inicio fue exigente, pero muy gratificante. A la media hora hicimos una pausa para recuperar el aliento, hidratarnos y continuar con más ánimo.
A medida que avanzábamos, entramos en un bosque de pinos realmente hermoso. El olor, el silencio y la vista hacían que todo se sintiera muy especial. El clima estuvo gris durante casi todo el recorrido, con bastante neblina y frío, pero eso lo hacía aún más mágico; era el clima perfecto para caminar sin sentir agotamiento extremo.
Seguimos subiendo y bajando por diferentes montañas, disfrutando cada tramo del camino. Durante todo el recorrido fuimos conversando, riendo y también teniendo momentos de silencio, conectando con el entorno. Se podían ver muchos helechos y una vegetación muy linda que hacía del paisaje algo único.
Es importante recordar que en este tipo de caminatas siempre debemos ir bien preparados: llevar zapatos cómodos, ropa adecuada para el frío, y un bolso con agua, comida y frutas, ya que en estas rutas no encontramos tiendas ni lugares para comprar nada.
El recorrido completo fue de aproximadamente 14 kilómetros, y nos tomó cerca de 6 horas. Empezamos a las 7 de la mañana y terminamos alrededor de las 3 de la tarde. Durante el camino hicimos varias pausas para tomar café, descansar y almorzar, lo cual hizo la experiencia aún más agradable y llevadera.
Finalmente, llegamos a un municipio llamado Versalles. Para cerrar el recorrido, tuvimos una última subida un poco inclinada, que puso a prueba nuestras energías, pero lo importante es que lo logramos. La sensación al llegar fue de satisfacción, alegría y orgullo.
Fue una experiencia muy bonita, llena de naturaleza, retos y buenos momentos. Sin duda, una caminata para repetir y seguir conectando con lo simple y lo esencial.
Gracias por leerme.

A hike with pleasant people is always much more enjoyable, and this one was no exception. We started by meeting in Caldas, with great energy early in the morning. From there, we took a car to Alto de Minas, a journey of approximately 12 to 15 kilometers, which took us between 20 and 30 minutes, surrounded by green landscapes that already began to connect us with nature.
Upon arrival, we took a break to have a hot coffee, perfect for the morning cold, and did a warm-up to prepare our bodies. That moment was ideal for taking a deep breath, relaxing, and starting to disconnect from the noise of routine.
Then we began the hike with an uphill climb through the mountain, following an ancestral path that felt full of history and tranquility. The start was challenging but very rewarding. After about half an hour, we took a break to catch our breath, hydrate, and continue with renewed energy.
As we moved forward, we entered a truly beautiful pine forest. The scent, the silence, and the view made everything feel very special. The weather was gray for almost the entire hike, with quite a bit of fog and cold, but that made it even more magical; it was the perfect weather to walk without feeling extreme exhaustion.
We continued going up and down different mountains, enjoying every part of the trail. Throughout the journey, we talked, laughed, and also had moments of silence, connecting with the surroundings. We could see many ferns and beautiful vegetation that made the landscape unique.
It’s important to remember that for this kind of hike, we should always be well prepared: wear comfortable shoes, appropriate clothing for the cold, and carry a bag with water, food, and fruit, since on these routes there are no shops or places to buy anything.
The entire route was approximately 14 kilometers, and it took us about 6 hours. We started at 7 in the morning and finished around 3 in the afternoon. Along the way, we made several stops to have coffee, rest, and eat lunch, which made the experience even more enjoyable and manageable.

ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, travelers! How are you all doing? I haven’t been around for a few days because I set off on a new adventure and was soaking up every place I visited. Before leaving, I had a post ready about a nighttime tour of Maracaibo, but I forgot to publish it and focused instead on enjoying the first few days of Holy Week with my daughters before heading out. ![InShot_20260406_162727766.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcC5h6Jop8vbkj4onbG5qqRKR79Bj3bCyuiTsF7bzyp73/InShot_20260406_162727766.jpg) On the other hand, Ricardo and I chose to visit the city at those hours because it has a unique charm that makes me so proud to have been born in this land—so much so that the emotion brings a tear to my eye. We started at the plaza named in honor of Alí Primera on Avenida el Milagro, where there is a monument to this Venezuelan musician and composer. ![20260327_191454.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxEca2EE8ZaJzTV8cNdCzNH39ZLs2GENXxQirhfR2gBf/20260327_191454.jpg) ![20260327_191545.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQahHRiL4yoeQkYwitJuDZfR8z7X244GfEWDkzfD63WWJ/20260327_191545.jpg) Next was the Zulia State Library, a space with facilities and rooms suited for those who love reading, regardless of their interests or age; each room is tailored to the reader’s needs. ![20260327_191803.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYXGc7zXpJ1QnZhkXRVmBvwpip6anfbu2QBf4BvYyfD6y/20260327_191803.jpg) We arrived at Vereda del Lago, where we spent a couple of hours skating. I got ready for it, but it had been so many years since I’d done it that I fell on my first try. To be honest, I immediately took off my skates because I hit my left arm and didn’t want an accident to affect my hands. Instead, we went to visit the Monument to the Naval Battle of Lake Maracaibo, which commemorates our victory over a Spanish fleet that sought to rule Maracaibo. ![IMG-20260328-WA0079.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6HCiJXftCkVLn1KDEjrei3m2eCH3p3Nmua6fDUCthWi/IMG-20260328-WA0079.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0104.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTKNk1Y5TFXqR7bzSib6TRKuhRi2WRTegcKCYmJk5BWf/IMG-20260328-WA0104.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0110.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVsBwKdrSbrv6kq4oUwuipMkrXSrEaNWFRzn4hnyE5drY/IMG-20260328-WA0110.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0116.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU32ArTyr9eSHchYBET1gxy1jNPSb6Q7oQHwUEppHyExj/IMG-20260328-WA0116.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0151.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcLZbfXgEzmM12Ei8mw2P6qarr4W4ArD3AVwoTjMVfCcK/IMG-20260328-WA0151.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0150.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdJQzdLySNVycTriRUHU4BeznPEAXxY9weYsLG5oowcSi/IMG-20260328-WA0150.jpg) Finally, we visited the historic district of Maracaibo, the heart of our city, where every little corner sparkled in the middle of the night with its blend of colors. We walked down the colorful Calle Carabobo, lined with colonial-style houses, and came upon the Plazoleta de la Virgen del Rosario de Chiquinquirá, a monument honoring our patron saint, and the Basilica of the same name, one of the most important churches with impressive architecture and design. ![IMG-20260328-WA0149.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcFsTRBWPmuJSomdW48K9Dc8uM1w4djgLciWeJwbuydjj/IMG-20260328-WA0149.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0119.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbM1dUtWeFA67Uj8aCeQZXnfVzEH86a9CZ1MLDKNDJTH7/IMG-20260328-WA0119.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0121.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVXaC9uddCu8BHhFCDPydMbTMjE9NZNoSacVBU1scmeuv/IMG-20260328-WA0121.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0124.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPHxoZc49BPnXgmz4RrnCGbKi71snpuaJBaVbivvE84Au/IMG-20260328-WA0124.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQjhSbnR88cSmLYrVndZdJdH8zEpnUxnpCzvzw5AtX3wD/IMG-20260328-WA0131.jpg) I love Maracaibo at night. I don’t know why I didn’t enjoy its streets after sunset before. The city is quiet, and the tranquility lets you enjoy the experience even more.

![IMG-20260328-WA0150.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdJQzdLySNVycTriRUHU4BeznPEAXxY9weYsLG5oowcSi/IMG-20260328-WA0150.jpg) Por último, visitamos el casco histórico de Maracaibo, el corazón de ## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRwmiksWU7K2LS42X8R32ReH8CZpVBYv8eU3bLXkip7BR/1775658497011.jpg) In this post I will share my experience when visiting a quite popular natural tourist destination in the city of Takengon, namely Temas River Park, this is my second visit to this tourist spot and in this visit I managed to find a lot of changes and striking differences and become a consideration for the future. I myself do not know how far the exact distance is between the city of Takengon and this tourist spot, but what is certain is that to get to this place I have to travel about 15 minutes . ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZGnd4mtY7NN5PnwirvtwAp6KQHVymLZ6Tr2Ev9Koik9/1775658497092.jpg) On the side of the highway we will find a banner or sign that says welcome to Temas River Park, and to get to the main area we have to travel another distance of about 1 minute. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT85ZrC3CSxxGZNNVg6BCdDzSaFip88HQ4Dvt2aQwCWWF/1775658497190.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXJEzo9cyPsPgGMUny1Lxzh7wNePhc5HpkTYkhAowoG72/1775658497288.jpg) And this is the view from the parking area, different from my previous visit, now the number of visitors coming to this tourist spot is getting smaller, we can see this from the number of vehicles parked there, but at that time I visited this tourist spot on a weekday. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1DxrfdPobnDiSZuNagKqiVmJbkAddnU19BgdRZVNyBD/1775658497391.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW3QmPbdsFde6biuXh6m1cztPjpTkDEW89MupQUCduxpV/1775658497489.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPfcPf8oScU9jwiUUm4pPfiqPopdWGpTBqLA1rf8vdXiL/1775658497593.jpg) In terms of scenery and natural atmosphere, it still feels the same and there is no difference at all, but as far as the eye can see, I did not see a single tent standing around this tourist spot, this made me wonder at that time, where did the tents that were the main attraction of this tourist spot go. There weren't many visitors at the time, and the good news for me was that I could explore the place to my heart's content, taking photos everywhere, capturing moments, and having fun to my heart's content. However, the place is still buzzing on social media,and I believe,this place will be crowded again during the next big holiday ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUUiwEVzEpbrYMHzGDxn2XPwRMkBeUnmkdF9GoPhGMHBo/1775658497682.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDJCnd8HeAD3mdrLPodVJ5gGGtu9SmzuCHgfr7rgo3GM/1775658497764.jpg) I can say that this tourist spot is right in the middle of a coffee plantation, so from this place we can see the natural scenery directly and feel the tranquility. At that time, I and several of my friends immediately took the opportunity to explore this place to our heart's content, I even took the time to visit the areas that I passed on my previous visit. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvJ9gXiXHz8sKRn84NJS8Rt3PQvX9SqYNhjpbk4CPZM3/1775658497855.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEXcXtWWNcrhDK65AZkJcQGgGfzBvxVQyKUYjKWeia8i/1775658497947.jpg) At this tourist spot there are also swimming pool facilities, there are even swimming pools for adults and for small children, but now the condition of the water in the pool looks a little dirty and cloudy, and is not as clear as before. This tourist spot is really suitable to visit with friends or with family, here we can do various exciting things such as fishing, grilling fish or chicken, camping and spending the night with fun things. However, now I don't see any tents standing on the riverbank, even though the natural scenery is still the same, but the facilities at this tourist spot have been reduced ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAQvL3PpSer1GmRWsDsQqyNDpq5Zb5eJfa5B2UyMxhKE/1775658498033.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvE6F4ayi9geacy2wZ1o8ggeCUbWp7Lt1tXjp441WZo9/1775658498127.jpg) While I was exploring this tourist spot, I immediately realized that the size of this tourist spot has become wider, and the number of huts has also increased, of course these are positive values ​​that are very useful for visitors. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbd8M6LV7mbirw2BCxqpxeZ6WfdVuLT18Gvt72hDCem1S/1775658498228.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRq6oL5Ef2VfvRcHZzJNmf9hNS6r2MihRb2nhC62basi/1775658673091.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGdpsU1zwSN3ueeu3TqkLvGYs5deTqvD7sa3yYs7jk9i/1775658498400.jpg) And this is the Peusangan River, one of the rivers with clear water conditions that originate directly from the tawar sea, this river is also very famous because it is one of the white water rafting routes in the city of Takengon. Do you know when is the best time to enjoy the beauty of this river.? According to information I got from the officers there, the best time to see the beauty of this river is in the morning when the morning dew still sticks to the leaves and the morning fog is still there, it is a beautiful sight and can only be enjoyed for a moment. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

![20260407_065003_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23wgHmDZhtUbUHBsKA5ojGTCwfMKd4hVii2YXa8rVfkuGCb975QrY1RGERGzn9eKhf8dZ.png)

Hellp everyone! 
You know living in Baler, Aurora, is pretty sweet. We are always surrounded by the ocean on one side and mountains on the other. It's like nature's best of both worlds, right? One afternoon i just felt like taking a little break and seeing things from a different angle.
 

![20260407_065004_0004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23w2h3DoDKDYkHCesrCX2QtxkfojbWphTN2aqk16kkSaqDCz84j3WGXW6U57e3mNa68GA.png)

I wanted to find that perfect spot you know where I could just take it all in. So I decided to head up Ermita Hills. That was my mission for the day to find the absolute best view where the land sea and sky all came together in one amazing picture. 
 

![20260407_065004_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/242NasyVENvvQ7W5WWsHHYiiUssroBgFLjfVeHZcPSPL7xDvS1iEuzT9j8e53dVTyTbGt.png)

I had a feeling it was going to be a good adventure and I was really looking forward to it. The drive up there was already cool. As I went higher the air started to smell super fresh a mix of the ocean and the trees. 
 

![20260407_065004_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/244deStW9uFZAZgwoF5h7jCAEYch3uWFVFpcwufA6Uiy9kWL9fLMH11AAAUjcNS2nxoTD.png)

It’s a nice change from the usual town smells kind of clearing your head. It started to feel like I was really leaving the everyday behind. Soon enough the regular road turned into more of a path and that’s when the real adventure began. 
 

![20260407_065004_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23qrNYnMw4ndcd23v1ShkLjAknCmTJHywVZb65cCFEC1H6uv2mdvzkBPx4A4jUTdouwr7.png)

The sun was peeking through the leaves of the big trees making these cool moving patterns on the ground. It was quiet too, with just birds chirping and leaves rustling. No city noise at all which was really nice. 
 
![20260407_065005_0010.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23w2gpcRLryELiZ7CR95Ai3e78xXdobR1NCQhntM5VmqS1b7j5eLcMirrkcTWfWJkpSDF.png)

It felt like a good warm up for what was coming like nature was setting the scene. The peaceful sounds made me feel calm and ready to see the amazing sights. I kept walking and the path sometimes had steps sometimes just dirt. 
 
![20260407_065005_0009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/246adLmGpw85ZKwez5UrqAdTDthuxdhyEbj9DgSwSVrQBBYWBbKk5DAZMEzAWcNomA1M8.png)


It winded through lots of green trees. Every now and then the trees would open up and i had get these awesome, quick peeks of the big blue ocean down below. It sparkled so much! Those little glimpses just made me want to get to the very top even more to see everything all at once. 
 

![20260407_065005_0008.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23sUEUHPMcBe6CKDBTagurZ1MF1PXqY81z4GvqEwDW26qM61vkd5ij6dDHywj9wV471ce.png)

I passed by some little areas with railings and they offered some nice views but I was looking for something bigger something where the horizon just stretched on forever. I wanted to see the whole picture of Baler’s amazing nature. 
 
![20260407_065005_0007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23zv2e2w8Y11T7MHJ9sw4oEdPnNs2MdA6PUziDGJ9ZWo25muQijtRnRPXZRFDA1BNTfjw.png)


Finally after a good walk up I made it to one of the main viewing spots at Ermita Hills. And wow just wow. The whole world just opened up beneath me. It was even better than those quick peeks! It was everything I hoped for and more. 
 

![20260407_065005_0006.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23sdbEgZEqC6kcp8YR5PKHjsJWSqG9ZteXPCDmrysc2gpQgawiH6fNLfaALiDJ3AzemKe.png)

To my left there was the long golden beach curving all the way out. You could see the waves gently rolling in little white lines on the huge blue ocean. I could even spot the bridge way out there looking tiny from up high. 
 

![20260407_065005_0005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/23xAPbjXCYDtRLGbQEEMtfQr1sic7KW2kjsypHmxnaHXKvuvD4ifDEDfTBxLj5SmCtPpL.png)

It was cool to see a little bit of town life mixed with all that nature. Then I looked to my right and the view changed a bit. It was still the ocean but this part looked a bit wilder with cool rocks sticking out of the water. 
 

![20260407_065006_0013.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/245cRkTSFrXtJd7EEpKydPVPSfAGu8ghkVEUZuUUepePLashBJz29kbaZQ4sobeFxJ8cs.png)


It was super blue over there too just a slightly different vibe. This side felt a bit more untouched, you know? And way out the Pacific Ocean just kept going and going. It makes you feel pretty small in a good way like you are part of something much bigger. 
 

![20260407_065006_0012.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/2449wwrJ2WS2arDy1GapwznJ5SV4srsxiLFtKrZT62GBGEeEYaXnnnTWfbbbbyWVrm8tm.png)

The sky was perfect too a soft blue with fluffy clouds just making everything look super chill and calm. It was truly a postcard perfect view. But I was not done searching for my "perfect spot" just yet. I saw a nice looking gazebo a little further along the ridge. 
 

![20260407_065006_0011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/246ahvsJ7ZpE2bvCJNwi8g38TEo9SuPvaVbzdVVgc25AEkGu9jtBwLcMToYBsuJwHQbv2.png)


It was surrounded by some grass and a few trees and it just looked like a comfy place to hang out. A few other people were there just chilling chatting and taking pictures. The gazebo itself was pretty and it framed the ocean view really well. From there I could see even more of the town nestled against the mountains like a quilt of green and houses.

Hello, @worldmapping community ❣️


Today, I want to share a very special trip my husband, my daughter, and I took.
We decided to hike a famous mountain in our town called Bala-an Bukid.
In our local language, "Bala-an" means holy, and "Bukid" means mountain.
Bala-an Bukid or The Holy Mountain. 😊

---

☀️ We started our adventure early at around 6:00 AM.
Even though the sun was just waking up, the foot of the mountain was already packed!
There were so many people at the foot of the mountain.
From young kids to older folks, all were heading to the top.


For our family, this isn't just a walk, it is a tradition.
We hike this mountain every summer during Holy Week.
We started doing this when my daughter was only 6 years old.
It is our way of renewing our faith and spending a great time together.
My daughter loves it and looks forward to it every year 😊

---
---

💪 Hiking Bala-an Bukid is a real workout!
It takes a lot of courage and leg strength.

A few years ago, the path was very rocky and steep. You had to be very careful and wear the right shoes. I could still remember how sore my feet were after stepping on the rocky paths. I used to grab on grass and weeds for support 😆.

And now, the path is much better!
Most of the parts are now flattened.
It is still steep, but they added bamboo handrails to help everyone stay safe, especially the elderly and the kids.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23ynNDmTSsSn133iXk5tEVKn4Ggh2ASFjSJvwS7gRbgwQd2FTt3URQYYbaBasBhraHy1d.jpg)

I love this last photo.
You can see people in front of us, old and young.
Trees on both sides provide shade and a cool temperature.
You'll also notice the blue sky above.
We are already near the peak.

---

Here, the path is almost no longer visible.
When you think that the last photo gives you relief, since the peak is just a

The path is way worse.
We need to climb on the rocks to go up.

---
---



Even when we get tired or sweaty, we keep going. Why?
Because the view from the top is amazing!
Looking down at the world from the peak makes all the hard work worth it.


![IMG_20260403_065514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vvodjiu/23wgB69gxiUCT59tsBeCo464r9eCteiFU5bYfLziky4WMZg5WitWWMEdSv5kpSUMtktFt.jpg)

It was a beautiful day for family bonding and a great way to feel closer to nature and our faith. If you love a good challenge with a reward at the end, this is the place to be!

**Gratos saludos tengan mis queridos viajeros de todas partes del mundo es un placer para mi saludarlos en este lunes inicio de semana hoy quiero mostrarlo el antiguo aeropuerto de la ciudad de Maracaibo que hoy en día es la facultad de ciencias.** **Warm greetings to my dear travellers from all corners of the globe. It is a pleasure for me to greet you on this Monday, the start of the week. Today I would like to show you the old airport in the city of Maracaibo, which is now home to the Faculty of Science.** Viajeros del mundo caminando y recorriendo todas las facultades de la Universidad del Zulia me encontré con una que particularmente es la que es más rica historia que todas y es la Facultad de ciencias en la actualidad, pero no obstante anteriormente era cede del antiguo "Aeropuerto de Grano de Oro", podemos que aunque han pasado casi 57 años de su clasura su fachada se conserva tal cual como en ese entonces sin ninguna modificación, pero ahora bien como este lugar de ser Aeropuerto, debido al fatídico accidente en el año 1969 justamente un 16 de Marzo, cuando unos de sus aviones cayó justamente en el sector Ziruma produciendo un sin fin de victimas muertas desde ese entonces dicierón cerrar por completo sus instalaciones. >As I wandered around the University of Zulia, exploring all its faculties, I came across one that is particularly rich in history: the Faculty of Science. Although it is now a faculty, it was previously the site of the old ‘Grano de Oro Airport’. Even though almost 57 years have passed since it closed, its façade remains exactly as it was back then, without any alterations, However, as this place was an airport, following the tragic accident in 1969, on 16 March to be precise, when one of its planes crashed in the Ziruma area, causing countless fatalities, it was decided to close the facility completely. ![1000437609.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/48KcHzztdMiPS9QywQq255tbCtg9acA92Qav17Qy5YVyZzgRueeZNJErvvhmB9Voxe.png) Ahora bien, el antiguo aeropuerto de la ciudad de Maracaibo fue fundado el 19 de Marzo de 1929, durante el gobierno del dictador Juan Vicente Gomez y en ese entonces estaba como Gobernador el General Perez Soto, el arquitecto acargo de esta obra fue Alejandro Chataing y su hijo Luis Eduardo,Luis Malaussena, Raúl Villanueva, León Jerome Hoet este último muy conocido por ser arquitecto de grandes obras de Maracaibo como lo es el teatro Baralt de la ciudad, este aerupuerto contaba con cuatro pistas de aterrisaje en las cuales estaban las cuatro líneas de KLM, Viasa, Ransa, Avensa PanAm, era un aeropuerto internacional que conectaba con diversas partes del mundo países de suramerica, el caribe, Estados Unidos y algunas partes Europa, estas zonas aledañas se fuerón expandiendo y creciendo en población por lo que se estaba pensando en reubicar este aeropuerto era una propuesta en ese entonces del estado Venezolano. >Now, the old airport in the city of Maracaibo was founded on 19 March 1929, during the rule of the dictator Juan Vicente Gómez; at that time, General Pérez Soto was Governor. The architects in charge of the project were Alejandro Chataing and his son Luis Eduardo, Luis Malaussena, Raúl Villanueva, and León Jerome Hoet – the latter being well known as the architect of major projects in Maracaibo, such as the city’s Baralt Theatre. This airport had four runways, which were used by the four airlines: KLM, Viasa, Ransa, and Avensa PanAm. It was an international airport connecting to various parts of the world, including countries in South America, the Caribbean, the United States and parts of Europe. As the surrounding areas expanded and their populations grew, plans were being considered to relocate the airport; this was a proposal put forward by the Venezuelan government at the time. ![20260317_100528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243qD7hHzcBP6TzDaxxLEU2PUynyDNiRb21Xri35jcuTTksqpZSVvqj7GQk5Xa3MpCmkX.jpg) ![20260317_100546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243WP9m8aDzrxgyPFNRaf7cqEyiuWeEnZ9vhPMkdW6cnBouj7JHNug3Ayxm9hSJ72d4xb.jpg) ![20260317_100621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/2432FU7WrQRhiNcqNYfBFm6RrnkMJfj8KeBVbd8UXSyN62AUTA61hnp6PA1MpRunSVEZN.jpg) Dando justamente una vista por la parte de atrás del antiguo aeropuerto apesar que todo este cubierto de mucha maleza, podemos observar las grandes letras de Maracaibo, por aquí era justamente donde salían los pasajeros para tomar sus aviones estas letras aún se conservan apesar que todo este enmontado este lugar podemos encontrarlos en algunas reseñas historicas de este lugar, un terrible suceso quedo enmaracado en la historia de nuestra localidad justamente el vuelo 742 de Viasa, este avión cubría la ruta, Maracaibo, Caracas y Miami, pues ocasiono la más grande tragedia de la décadas de los 60, este avión justamente llego desde Caracas a las 11:30 para colocar combustible, iba con destino a Miami, el avión despego a las 12:00 pm del mediodía, después ocurrió el fatídico accidente se dice que el sistema del avión fallo. >Taking a look at the back of the old airport, even though it’s all overgrown with weeds, we can still make out the large letters spelling ‘Maracaibo’. This was precisely where passengers used to board their flights; these letters are still preserved, even though the whole area is overgrown. We can find references to this place in some historical accounts; a terrible event remains etched in the history of our town: Viasa Flight 742. This aircraft operated the route between Maracaibo, Caracas and Miami, and it caused the greatest tragedy of the 1960s. The plane had just arrived from Caracas at 11.30 am to refuel; it was bound for Miami. The plane took off at 12.00 pm, and then the fateful accident occurred; it is said that the aircraft’s systems failed. ![20260317_100518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23zkhxZa5wnRcKXGd8GygbjXJYjSoywyGAiYSw11Ra2Y7wdP5b9idXDj84XpNA4HFdGdq.jpg) ![20260317_100508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243q8gsfpuNHTPPohumoownkV6CQvNrEtb9onxteM2gMMPeCEprfLbVy1g8mWbokt9GKr.jpg) ![20260317_100824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23ywm1wvsyuuVtgtAKfeyj8bAUPM89CRNp9HuxGrtaSX2q6JJ2UyMvEixMk7jKmSQSxj1.jpg) ![20260317_100507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243BaLBixr8TW2QGcYknKmoUmJsR7zh5EzSmrETWVLnhpJ6vMezQcE4zZzqzBC3gL3CyU.jpg) --- El avión tenía sobrepeso, al llegar la nave choco con unos arboles y esto también produjo un desperfecto mecánico ocasionando daños en el fuselaje, en el sistema también, justamente cuando esta estaba despegando el avión no quería alcanzar la altura por lo que solo sobrevolar por la zona, el avión cayó justamente en la urbanización ziruma, 155 personas perdierón vida 84 de ellos del avión y 71 personas que se encontraban en tierra en el sector Ziruma, se encontraban grandes personalidades en este vuelo el Latigo Perez un famoso beibolista, Carlos Santeliz y Antonio Herrera Gutierrez dueño del equipo Cardenales de Lara. >The aircraft was overloaded; upon arrival, it collided with some trees, which also caused a mechanical failure, resulting in damage to the fuselage and the systems. Just as it was taking off, the aircraft was unable to gain altitude and so merely flew over the area; The plane crashed in the Ziruma residential area; 155 people lost their lives, 84 of them on board the aircraft and 71 people on the ground in the Ziruma area. There were several prominent figures on this flight, including Latigo Perez, a famous baseball player, Carlos Santeliz, and Antonio Herrera Gutierrez, owner of the Cardenales de Lara team. ![20260317_100904.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23zbKkCHsjCrrZZKjHGfqCp4Qg7L66nzZm2YWkpvnQtCPhKM2QL416yYMnjPnCAD2Df8K.jpg) ![20260317_100842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/243Lvi6P6Mv8HpDrgqvqKAYTWehbxoLGTEZpYMLEYvf2BuftANACL5CyqACfu8e5ZvvYp.jpg) --- Después del cierre del aeropuerto la Universidad del Zulia decidió tomar estos terrenos, remodelando así algunos sitios de este lugar para adapatarlo como facultad, donde ahora funciona la Facultad Experimental de Ciencias, donde se dan las carreras de licenciatura en química, matemática, fisica, ciencias de la computación y antropología, la Universidad sólo hizo adaptaciones a su arquitectura original, quedando la infraestructura perfecta para ser una gran casa de estudios, ahora bien la edificación principal del antiguo aeropuerto es la cede de la Universidad del Zulia siendo la facultad de ciencias en la actualidad, pero las pistas de aterrisaje de todo lo que constituye el antiguo aeropuerto es todo el sector grano de Oro. >Following the closure of the airport, the University of Zulia decided to take over this land, refurbishing parts of the site to convert it into a faculty building. It now houses the Experimental Faculty of Sciences, which offers undergraduate degrees in chemistry, mathematics, physics, computer science and anthropology. The University merely made adjustments to the original architecture, leaving the infrastructure perfectly suited to serve as a great centre of learning. Now, the main building of the former airport serves as the headquarters of the University of Zulia, currently housing the Faculty of Sciences, whilst the runways and the entire area comprising the former airport now form the Grano de Oro district. ![20260317_100902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/242DDuvSTNSHxQ4vmh8zFvj1DSmAkbmjDiZMWUvuhg6waStYA9E5uFvzE4az6PpE1ZKJc.jpg) ![20260317_100951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23u67G1QetR8ugKxD9zSr9h6Q3KG9RkR4B7fppjrB68u4jFXoZSPYecCx4qQ1jBTT7SGj.jpg) ![20260317_100934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23wqiZtZAAaSy639z67uZDBgHGquxfGNpwLenbpig5KVVG9dhEzRXPH6kBD1AF3niVni7.jpg) ![20260317_101035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23tmKbzG9WpHAVjdDSoUoqNVRZBdcHRENiXGe3YJu5EcQcWnb9aMbf59Zv2Bxxq14ceJp.jpg) ![20260317_101112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uQxodTiAHQJMRZ4RCvBvaBNUZEKvUTt5Z2ZBgUbgSLzmB7UY7XCKnE6GuYWdxFqRGuM.jpg) --- Podemos ver como un lugar que ha quedado marcado fatidicamente para la historia se le pudo dar un uso importante que cada día da aportes a jóvenes de la ciudad, algunas de las pistas de avión el antiguo aeropuerto constituyen la facultad de humanidades y ciudad universitaria, como también el estacionamiento ahora es el parque monumental Ana María Campos un especio hermoso para la recreación, la esencia de ese antiguo aeropuerto sigue reposando en nuestra ciudad y en cada fachada de esta linda casa de estudio, se dice que algunas de las personas que perdierón la vida en el fatal accidente, algunas pueden verlas con vestimenta de la epoca en algunas zonas de la ciudad, mis viajeros espero les haya gustado mucho este lugar lleno de tanta historia. >We can see how a place that has been fatally marked by history has been given a significant new purpose, one that benefits the city’s young people every day. Some of the former airport’s runways now form part of the Faculty of Humanities and the University Campus, whilst the car park has been transformed into the Ana María Campos Monumental Park, a beautiful space for recreation. The essence of that old airport still lingers in our city and on every façade of this lovely house of learning. It is said that some of the people who lost their lives in the fatal accident can be seen, dressed in period costume, in certain parts of the city. My fellow travellers, I hope you have thoroughly enjoyed this place, so steeped in history. ![20260317_101113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uFa4rQynhWFsy15auqMmZjWREMUS72q4G3ZrCRXdJ19HZuqoXcdXBJXe6fimrxiFbmQ.jpg) ![20260317_101124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uQxodTgj3qgkXnEyYr8Dd7CLJA3KdmJeLe1N4TVW9ig5Vxrev6Y2rnNe5WzzKnkwmTK.jpg) ![20260317_101125.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uQxjDzcYwirmSsM6uSA5Duq3nLZhWFztpJtcJehotzHg3PJU9WFBxE3Czq9tvUSU5vz.jpg) ![20260317_101415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/23uFeDuWnyDueqSu9oFmS6UPNwHcXkhViRsBApfpBbiwNAj4P9FG8C9cJFQj8GuDiyJjk.jpg) Me despido hasta una proxima oportunidad mis queridos amigos viajeros hasta pronto. >I’ll say goodbye for now, my dear fellow travellers see you soon. ![20260317_101420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/noelyss/Ep5mfx9dFAKt4B39jrX5izGK8PbQbV762WuWTSxXErZgsCLSR3V6E7TaxmuePVfLPFS.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.67208 lat -71.63628 long d3scr)
